name: Auto Apply Coupons by Smart Coupons for WooCommerce
author: storeapps

sections.description:
Auto apply discount coupons or promo codes at cart/checkout for customers. No need to create them programmatically. This eliminates manual entry, making shopping experience smooth!

Features:

  • Go live quickly – Simply create a coupon and select it for auto-apply. The plugin handles the rest.
  • Set any coupon as auto-apply – Create unlimited auto-apply coupons, but only one coupon can be set to auto-apply at a time.
  • Supports multiple discount types – Auto-apply percentage discounts, fixed cart discounts, and product discounts. Also works with store credits and other discount types supported under the default WooCommerce ‘Discount type’ option.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce Subscriptions – Auto-apply subscription coupons like sign-up fee and recurring product discount.
  • Cart-based rules – Set minimum or maximum cart total to control when a coupon is auto-applied.
  • Product-based rules – Automatically apply coupons only when specific products or categories are in the cart.
  • WooCommerce Blocks compatible

Note: Discounts auto-apply only when there’s at least one product in the cart.

Best use cases of auto-apply coupons

  • Black Friday, Cyber Monday, or Christmas sales
  • New Year, Valentine’s Day, store anniversary, or any special occasion
  • Flash sales
  • New product launches, events, stock clearance sales
  • For loyal customers to encourage repeat purchases

Benefits of auto-apply coupons

  • Reduces coupon code errors – No more typing errors or forgotten coupon codes.
  • Encourages higher conversions – Instant discounts applied nudges customers to complete the purchase.
  • Enhances mobile shopping experience – Checkout is faster and smoother, especially for mobile shoppers as manual coupon code entry is eliminated.
  • Create personalized codes – Send exclusive coupon code via email to a specific customer with auto-apply enabled. The customer will feel special, boosting loyalty.
  • Reduces support queries – Fewer customers contacting support about coupon-related issues means saved time and resources.

With WooCommerce auto coupons, you create a seamless experience that drives faster checkouts and sales.

Advanced auto apply coupon features in the PRO version

Check out the official Smart Coupons plugin by StoreApps for more flexibility and advanced options.

Allow multiple auto-apply coupons

By default, up to five coupons can be auto-applied at once. A simple code tweak allows more auto-applied coupons.

Set advanced restrictions

Auto apply WooCommerce coupons based on payment methods, location, user roles, emails, shipping method, product attributes, product taxonomy, and quantity discounts.

Bulk generate auto apply coupons

Create thousands of unique coupon codes and set them to auto-apply.

Auto-apply coupons via URL

Add multiple coupon promo codes to a URL and automatically apply discounts when customers click the link.

Auto-apply BOGO deals

Offer a free product automatically when customers buy a qualifying item.

Gift cards, discount rules, and more

Get gift cards, store credits, cashbacks, bulk discounts, buy one get one deals, discount rules, advanced restrictions, flash sales, and more…all in a single powerful package.

Smart Coupons eliminate the need for buying multiple advanced coupon plugins and save you $500+.

sections.installation:
1. Unzip and upload contents of the plugin to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Auto Apply Coupons. Search & select a coupon under Select a Coupon for Auto Apply for which you want to enable auto apply.
  4. Save the settings.
sections.faq:
How to auto apply a coupon in WooCommerce?

  • Install and activate this plugin.
  • Create a coupon, set restrictions, limits, and publish it.
  • Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Auto apply coupons.
  • Search and enter the coupon code created above and save the settings.

How do I add a 20% discount in WooCommerce?

  • Create a coupon.
  • Set the discount type to ‘Percentage discount’.
  • Enter 20 as the discount amount.
  • Set restrictions and publish.
